subject_line: An Author Spotlight for True Treasure
email_body:
Hi Laura,

I came across The Dragon and the Girl series and was taken with the premise of True Treasure, where twelve-year-old Eliana uses her ability to communicate with dragons to solve a mystery about an ancient treasure, and with the news that a third book is on the way in 2026.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

With a dragon adventure that is so visual, a cinematic book trailer or a few short promotional reels could be a lovely way to introduce new readers to the world of the series, especially as Book 3 approaches. If a trailer for True Treasure or the series is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it is entirely an optional add-on to the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit True Treasure best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
